title: Helicopter movement from USS Princeton

paragraphs.text: On 19 November, the battalion conducted a PHIBLEX—a landing exercise—with helicopter movement from USS Princeton to Camp Pendleton.

Three rifle companies and elements of Headquarters and Service Company participated. The report places the companies at approximately 40% manning; it does not identify the three rifle companies by name.

notes: Three rifle companies participated; this entry does not identify them individually.
Map destination is a contextual location view, not the exact position of each action.

The narrative says mid-November; the detailed chronology supplies November 19. Company manning here is separate from the approximately 50% battalion strength reported for the special training program.
